items.evidence: AC#1 test passes; it asserts exit 0, the Options, Table, Hands played and violations lines, and the order of all 11 labels. Spawned run by hand: exit 0 in 0.35 s, exact §5 lines in order.

Locked test passes. Holdout: 95,000 hands over 5 configs. Every hand has stacks 160, a non-null result, code = handReplayCode(seed,k) and the button per A-2. For 60 random (seed, size, k) hands, replayHand(record) gives a state identical to final (JSON equal) and the deck equals shuffledDeck(code).

Locked test passes (seats 1..n, 2n distinct hole cards, n=3..10, spawned size 10). Holdout: CLI runs at sizes 3, 8, 9 and 10 print 'Table: <n> players' with the right hand count. Random-size replays (3..10) print exactly n seat lines.
Locked test passes (=== of spawned stdout pairs). By hand: cmp shows identical output for 10000/42 and for 5000/1/3, 5000/99/10, 100000/7/8 and 2000/42/9.
Locked test asserts the exact first/last codes for seeds 42 and 43 and disjoint sets. Holdout: 200 seeds x 50 hands give 10,000 distinct codes. Spawned seed 42 vs 43 replay-code lines differ.

Locked test passes (hole cards, board order, burned, result, CLI replay block). Holdout: 60 random size/seed/hand cases. Replay-mode output equals formatHand of run hand k (renumbered), playHand reproduces it, and replayHand matches the full final state. Divergence at index 2 and past the end gives 'Replay diverged at action <i>'.

Unit test builds real betCount-4 preflop and turn spots offering fold/call/raise, checks 1000 seeds give only fold/call, and uses a betCount-3 control that raises. Mutants >4 and no-cap are killed (9 tests fail). Holdout: 3000 real hands driven decision by decision; every choice is legal, and at betCount>=4 none is bet/raise. Choice is uniform within 5% over 30,000 draws.

Locked test passes (max <=4, capped >0, summary.cappedStreets equal, violations 0). Holdout: 95,000 in-process hands plus a 100,000-hand CLI run show max bets per street = 4, the cap reached many times, and 0 violations.

Locked test checks exact stderr = message + USAGE, empty out and no echo for 5 bad values plus a missing value; also a spawned uppercase case. By hand: --replay-code XYZ and an ANSI-escape value exit 2 with the fixed text and no echo. Holdout: leading space, trailing newline and an OSC-escape code all give the fixed message.

Unit test asserts the exact {code:2,out:'',err:msg+USAGE} for every spec row, plus help, defaults and the largest seed. Holdout: 41 extra hostile argv (empty, whitespace, +5, 5.0, 0x10, fullwidth digits, 23-digit, 2^64, escape sequences, -h, --, positional, case variants, duplicates of every option, button 0/7/11, help combos) all give exit 2, no stdout and the exact fixed line. Accepted edges parse to normalised values (hands 1e9, seed 0, size 03 -> 3, max seed, button 10 of 10, option order).

Unit test asserts the 3 worked examples, RangeError for 0/1.5, buttons 1,2,3,1,2,3,1 and seat-generator determinism/difference. Mutants on button, word 2 and seat seed are killed. Holdout: max-seed code 001fffffffffffff...0001, seed-0 code valid, RangeError for 0/-1/1.5/NaN.

Unit tests: the rejected-raise factory gives 3 violations with post-blind final states; the always-raise factory gives >=1; main returns 1 and prints 'Result: abandoned (invariant violation)'. Mutants removing either counter or forcing exit 0 are killed.

Full-string formatReport and formatHand comparisons (split showdown, Board: none fold-out) and replayHand 'Replay diverged at action 0' pass. The hand-header mutant is killed. The largestPot computation is not checked by any test (J-1-01, MEDIUM). Holdout confirms it is correct: it equals the independent max of chips committed per hand in all 5 runs.

npm run lint exit 0, npm run typecheck exit 0, npm test exit 0 with thresholds met (100% lines). git diff eb7839e -- src/engine is empty. The react/ui and network greps on src/playtest and tools/playtest find nothing.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected the suite to fail if 'Largest pot' were computed wrongly (§5 Rules 4: max over hands of the sum of award amounts). Actual: two mutants pass all 18 playtest tests. One reports the last hand's pot instead of the max; the other sums award.pot (always 0) instead of award.amount. The behaviour itself is correct today (verified independently).
findings.fix: Add a test that asserts summary.largestPot from a real multi-hand run (or summarize of two hands with the larger first) equals the max of the per-hand award sums.

summary: All 15 SPEC items PASS. The suite is green (128 passed), as are lint, typecheck and CI on HEAD ec5c4c31. End-to-end runs are deterministic and byte-identical, replay mode reproduces run hands at sizes 3..10, no street exceeds 4 bets across ~200k hands, and hostile argv get the fixed messages with exit 2 and no echo. Integrity is clean. One non-blocking MEDIUM test gap: largestPot is not checked by any test.
